# Thornbury Logistics -- Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement

This fictional Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement between Halvard Systems and Thornbury Logistics covers freight brokerage and supply-chain visibility services and the commercial terms that apply to it. It is synthetic evaluation data, not legal advice and not a real agreement.

## Term and Renewal

The current term of this Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement between Halvard Systems and Thornbury Logistics runs until 2027-12-11 and renews automatically for an additional twelve (12) month term on the same terms. Either party may prevent renewal by giving notice thirty (30) days in advance of the renewal date; renewal does not change the agreed fees.

## Termination

Termination for convenience is available to Halvard Systems on sixty (60) days notice. Thornbury Logistics may terminate for cause only where Halvard Systems fails to pay undisputed fees and does not cure within ten (10) days of written notice.

## Confidentiality

Each party shall protect the Confidential Information of the other with at least the care it applies to its own. Thornbury Logistics and Halvard Systems shall disclose Confidential Information only to personnel who need it to perform this Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement, and these obligations survive for five (5) years after termination.

## Governing Law

This Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement is governed by the laws of the Province of Ontario, excluding its conflict-of-laws rules. Halvard Systems and Thornbury Logistics submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of the Province of Ontario.

## Notices

Any notice, including notice of non-renewal or termination, must be in writing and sent to contracts@thornbury.example.com or contracts@halvard.example.com as applicable. Notices sent to any other address are not effective under this Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement.

## Signatures

Signed for Halvard Systems by Marit Halvorsen, Director of Procurement. Signed for Thornbury Logistics by Dara Okonjo, VP Customer Accounts. All signatories named in this document are fictional and no real person is represented.
